name: healthsim-populationsim
description: PopulationSim provides population-level intelligence using public data sources. Use this skill for ANY request involving: (1) population demographics or profiles, (2) geographic health patterns or disparities, (3) social determinants of health (SDOH), (4) SVI or ADI analysis, (5) cohort definition or specification, (6) clinical trial feasibility, site selection, or enrollment projection, (7) service area analysis, (8) health equity assessment, (9) census data or ACS variables, (10) CDC PLACES health indicators.
